reviews.t: Perfect for better looking galaxy nails!
reviews.x: I deliberately ordered Northern Lights silver holo topper after reading about how thinly scattered the holo bits are.  When I do galaxy nails, I use 2 or 3 of the scattered holo toppers, layered with a super thick, quick drying top coat, so it gives depth and dimension to my nails, and for the stars that appear farthest away, I prefer a micro-micro glitter that is not densely packed, and apply those coats in reverse, with the  smallest/thinnest one going last. ive used this for a long time and love it. I have tried other top coats and nothing compares. It dries super fast, leaves a high shine and a little shimmer of holo.

Great product. Adds just the right amount of bling without being gaudy.  Aids in quick drying and gives a beautiful top coat protective shine to you nails  all in one bottle. I found one in Sally's but when I looked for more they were out. Ordered online and quickly received 2  bottles securely wrapped and protected will be looking for more to have on hand.

My new standard top coat. Dries almost instantly, hardens quick, adds a great sparkle touch to any nail art or mani. I used to use whatever quick dry top coat that was cheap, or Sally Hansen's mega shine top coat, which can be a lot more expensive depending on where you find it. Don't bother; This stuff is magic.

reviews.t: My Favorite Quick Dry Top Coat!
reviews.x: Really worth it and one of my favorite top coats!  Nice thinly scattered hologram glitter that gives a hint of sparkle without being overwhelming.  Dries very fast and gives a nice shine.  Glad I grabbed two bottles!!!
I've loved this top coat for years and will cry if it ever goes away!  Beautiful addition of subtle sparkle to you polish, and does a great job getting the polish set and dried.  LOVE it!
I love hologram effects .  I bought this before.  Very nice quality,  Easy application, easy removal.

I'm not too impressed by this polish.  You definitely will never get a solid Hologram looking nail.  I thought I could.  I had seen this mentioned on someones Instagram and the persons nails were silver and holographic looking.  This polish doesn't have nearly enough glitter in it to ever look solid.  You'd probably have to 20 coats.  And I did shake it well.  It's only good for a very very fine glitter top coat.  I guess it's great if that's what you are looking for.  Revlon makes a polish name

I've been using this topcoat for years! Recently I wasn't able to find it locally, so took to the internet to see if I could find another retailer that had it. Was delighted to find the product here. You really have to give it a very brisk shake to get the glitter distributed through the top coat, and if you're looking for an intense payoff, it's going to take more than one coat. reviews.t: The Very Best Top Coat EVER!
reviews.x: So I love this soo much! I buy several bottles a year! I wear OPI colors but live on a rural homestead. The chores are very hard on my hands & nails. Even OPI wears off in a day. When I use this as a topcoat over the OPI, it is beautiful & my nails stay perfect for 10+ days! Lets my OPI stay on longer! adds just the right sparkle. Huge improvement! and pretty nails are really nice, even just for feeding chickens and sheep, cleaning shop & shopping the feed & farm stores.

I really love this polish! It has beautiful holo sparkles. That shine rainbow perfectly. Although it is kind of annoying that you really have to get in there and shake it super hard to mix it up. It is very thin so I always use a quick dry topcoat if I have done nail art otherwise it will smudge your design. it really adds something special but not overpowering when added on top of any polish though!

Super great top coat. I would recommend this product beyond any others I've tried.  It takes a little while to get the glitter off the bottom of the bottle, but that is a bonus for me.  It is a super hard top coat with teeny tiny glitter within. You can control how much glimmer you want by how much you roll/shake the bottle.

reviews.t: If you want that little something extra
reviews.x: Not a professional nail tech this is a great top coat with a little bit of sparkle I talk with my hands I always have someone grab my fingers to look at my nails because it’s not that noticeable but I think it’s just that little shine
Love this very scattered 'holo taco.'  You have to shake it a lot to free up the glitter, but it gives tiny discrete sparks of glitter and looks great over black polish.
Definitely recommend it.  It makes your nails look so shiny like you're wearing shellac and it makes the color last longer.
Great product looking for more hologram look not quite what I was looking for but love it adds bling to the ordinary polish
Glitter is so small , it takes a couple coats to be able to even see it. Used this product  for years  its not the same.
Love this quick dry topcoat with a holo glitter because it adds just the right amount of glitter and a good shine.
Love this. It add just the right amount of sparkle in the sunshine!

reviews.x: I love the additional highlight it adds to my favorite nail color
does not shake up well, even when I stir it with a toothpick

Nor did it have the "incredible shine" reviews noted. Mine had almost a matte effect compared to my standard Seche Vite. But most importantly, this actually took OFF my polish! I liked how quickly I could remove the polish with acetone. No scrubbing to get it off.   I got these as sort of a replacement for three Avon Snow Globe polishes that I own. I have been using this topcoat for a long time. Until the last year, I was able to purchase it at Sally Beauty Supply. They stopped carrying it and thankfully, I can order through Amazon.  This holographic topcoat looks great on light, as well as dark polish. I love looking at my polish with that something extra. I hope that I can continue to purchase it through Amazon. I don't want to be without it.

This stuff has been my absolute favorite polish for SO long.  It's perfection.  Goes on flawlessly, dries completely in SECONDS, removes easily, and is just a really lovely hint of sparkle without the typical glittery overkill. It's great as a top coat or on its own.  Love love love it!!  I'll buy it as long as they make it!!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the fast drying time and high-shine finish of this top coat.
Many reviewers love the subtle, scattered holographic sparkle that adds a hint of bling without being overwhelming.
Several reviewers note that the glitter settles and requires vigorous shaking to distribute it through the polish.
Some reviewers find the holographic effect too sparse, expecting a more solid or intense glitter look.
Reviewers report that it helps manicures last longer and protects the polish underneath.
